Class UIComponents

java.lang.Object
stockly.ui.UIComponents
public final class UIComponents extends Object
Reusable styled Swing components shared across the application.

These components replace default-looking Swing widgets with the Stockly visual language: rounded cards, flat forest buttons, soft hover states and pill-shaped status badges.

Author:
Tooba Akram & Abeeha Noor
